LanguageData.LP_CG_Brilliant.degreeDatas.color5B9BD5c: {PAWN_nameDef} has a photographic memory and can recite any tome after reading it once.\n\nNovice: Intelligence +2 (cap +2); research speed +15%

LanguageData.LP_CG_Commanding.degreeDatas.color5B9BD5: When {PAWN_nameDef} speaks, everyone falls silent to listen.\n\nNovice: Charisma +2 (cap +2); social impact +20%
LanguageData.LP_CG_Flurry.degreeDatas.color5B9BD5colo: {PAWN_nameDef}'s blade is so fast only afterimages remain.\n\nNovice: melee cooldown -20%; melee hits have a 15% chance of an immediate follow-up strike
